title: Everyday Phrases — Moving into a Dorm Room
scene_zh: 宿舍生活 · 情境對話
title_quote: Here we are, the dorm building.
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🛏️ 實用「入住大學宿舍」必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Moving into a Dorm Room
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用「入住大學宿舍」情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫）。場景是宿舍生活：搬進大學宿舍的第一天：領鑰匙、跟室友分床位與書桌、講好幾點關燈，去福利社補枕頭與檯燈，晚上一起去食堂吃飯，回來聊門禁與洗衣房。400 句循環聽，A2 程度，零基礎也能跟著開口說。#英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical 'Moving into a Dorm Room' phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue). The first day in a university dorm: picking up the key, splitting bunks and desks with a roommate, agreeing on lights-out, buying a pillow and a lamp, then dinner in the canteen. 400 lines on repeat, A2 level, easy to repeat out loud even from zero.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here we are, the dorm building.
dialogue.zh: 我們到了，這就是宿舍大樓。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It looks bigger than the photo.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this the front desk?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and someone is working there.
dialogue.zh: 對，而且有人在裡面工作。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, where is room three twelve?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪkˈskjuz mi wɛr ɪz rum θri twɛlv?/
dialogue.zh: 不好意思，312 房在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is on the third floor.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I get my key now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, just sign this paper first.
dialogue.zh: 當然，先在這張紙上簽名。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you need my student card?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, please show it to me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My name is Chen, with a C.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ neɪm ɪz tʃɛn wɪð ə si./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks, I found your name here.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，我在這裡找到你的名字了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is my roommate already inside?
dialogue.zh: 我的室友已經在裡面了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I think he checked in already.
dialogue.zh: 我想他已經辦好入住了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many suitcases can I bring?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two is fine, but not more.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where can I park my bike?
dialogue.zh: 我的腳踏車可以停哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There is a rack behind the building.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə ræk bɪˈhaɪnd ðə ˈbɪldɪŋ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That elevator is right over there.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, my bags are really heavy.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我的行李真的很重。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me help you with that bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi hɛlp ju wɪð ðæt bæɡ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You are too kind, thanks.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the elevator working today?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it just came down.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please hold the door for me.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No problem, I am holding it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which button goes to the third floor?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ ˈbʌtən ɡoʊz tu ðə θɜrd flɔr?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That one, next to the red light.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wʌn nɛkst tu ðə rɛd laɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This hallway is long and quiet.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most students are still on break.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our room is at the end, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər rum ɪz æt ði ɛnd raɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 我們的房間在盡頭，對嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the last door on the left.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə læst dɔr ɑn ðə lɛft./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here is three twelve, this is it.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ɪz θri twɛlv ðɪs ɪz ɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me try the key first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the key work on this door?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə ki wɜrk ɑn ðɪs dɔr?/
dialogue.zh: 這把鑰匙能開這扇門嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it turns very easily.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This room is darker than I thought.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs rum ɪz ˈdɑrkər ðæn aɪ θɔt/
dialogue.zh: 這個房間比我想的還暗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The light switch is by the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə laɪt swɪtʃ ɪz baɪ ðə dɔr./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you turn on the light?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, now I can see everything.
dialogue.zh: 好，現在我什麼都看得見了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our window is closed and locked.
dialogue.zh: 我們的窗戶關著而且鎖上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can open it for fresh air.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kæn ˈoʊpən ɪt fɔr frɛʃ ɛr./
dialogue.zh: 我們可以打開它通通風。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two beds and two desks are here.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu bɛdz ænd tu dɛsks ɑr hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 這裡有兩張床和兩張書桌。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is just what the room needs.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz dʒʌst wʌt ðə rum nidz/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My luggage is still in the hall.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈlʌɡɪdʒ ɪz stɪl ɪn ðə hɔl./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let us bring it in together.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Put the big suitcase by the wall.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊt ðə bɪɡ ˈsutˌkeɪs baɪ ðə wɔl./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, it fits under the bed.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We made it to our room.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and the key is ours now.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ænd ðə ki ɪz ˈaʊərz naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 對，而且鑰匙現在是我們的了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did the door just open by itself?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ðə dɔr dʒʌst ˈoʊpən baɪ ɪtˈsɛlf/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is probably my new roommate.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi there, I am Alex.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice to meet you, I am Ben.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs tu mit ju aɪ æm bɛn/
dialogue.zh: 很高興認識你，我是 Ben。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So you are my roommate this year?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ju ɑr maɪ ˈrumˌmeɪt ðɪs jɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 所以你是我今年的室友嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and I came here early.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long have you been here?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just since this morning, actually.
dialogue.zh: 其實就從今天早上開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this your first year too?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I am new to this city.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs aɪ æm nu tu ðɪs ˈsɪti./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which bed did you pick?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I already put my things up there.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ɔlˈrɛdi pʊt maɪ θɪŋz ʌp ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 我已經把東西放上面了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You mean the top bunk?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, is the top one okay?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the bottom bunk still free?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is free, so take it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I sleep better on the lower bed.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ slip ˈbɛtər ɑn ðə ˈloʊər bɛd./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fine, the bottom bunk is yours.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about the desks and chairs?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take the desk on that side.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Papers and books are all over it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpeɪpərz ænd bʊks ɑr ɔl ˈoʊvər ɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sorry, I will clear it tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We can share the big lamp.
dialogue.zh: 我們可以共用那盞大台燈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, one lamp is enough for us.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd wʌn læmp ɪz ɪˈnʌf fɔr ʌs./
dialogue.zh: 好，一盞台燈對我們來說夠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many shelves do we have?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three, so we each get one.
dialogue.zh: 三層，所以我們各用一層。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What time do you usually sleep?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I go to bed around midnight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is later than my usual time.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ˈleɪtər ðæn maɪ ˈjuʒuəl taɪm./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can still keep the room quiet.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kæn stɪl kip ðə rum ˈkwaɪət./
dialogue.zh: 我們還是可以讓房間保持安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you mind music in the morning?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju maɪnd ˈmjuzɪk ɪn ðə ˈmɔrnɪŋ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not really, but please use headphones.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My headphones are in my bag.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, then we will not fight.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，那我們就不會吵架。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When do you do your laundry?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Probably on the weekend mornings.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I wake up early to run.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is fine, I sleep through it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz faɪn aɪ slip θru ɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we keep the room tidy?
dialogue.zh: 我們可以讓房間保持整潔嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, I hate a messy floor.
dialogue.phonetic: /əv kɔrs aɪ heɪt ə ˈmɛsi flɔr./
dialogue.zh: 當然，我討厭地板亂七八糟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then let us make two simple rules.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn lɛt ʌs meɪk tu ˈsɪmpəl rulz./
dialogue.zh: 那我們就訂兩條簡單的規矩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, quiet after eleven at night.
dialogue.zh: 好，晚上十一點後保持安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And no food on the desks?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, we eat in the dining hall.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt wi it ɪn ðə ˈdaɪnɪŋ hɔl./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does this closet look small for two?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðɪs ˈklɑzɪt lʊk smɔl fɔr tu/
dialogue.zh: 這個衣櫃對兩個人來說會不會太小？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My clothes might not all fit.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe we can share one shelf.
dialogue.zh: 也許我們可以共用一層架子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let us try that for now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more thing, I sometimes snore.
dialogue.zh: 還有一件事，我有時會打呼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Really? Then I need earplugs tonight.
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？那我今晚需要耳塞。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is almost dinner time already.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let us finish unpacking after dinner.
dialogue.zh: 我們晚餐後再繼續拆行李。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your boxes are still on the floor.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr ˈbɑksɪz ɑr stɪl ɑn ðə flɔr./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I know, I will move them soon.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ noʊ aɪ wɪl muv ðɛm sun./
dialogue.zh: 我知道，我很快就會移開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where should we put the shoes?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Under my bed, next to yours.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have a towel with you?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju hæv ə ˈtaʊəl wɪð ju?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not yet, I need to buy one.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt jɛt aɪ nid tu baɪ wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 還沒有，我需要去買一條。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Down the hall is the bathroom.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is it shared with other students?
dialogue.zh: 是跟其他學生共用的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eight people use it on this floor.
dialogue.phonetic: /eɪt ˈpipəl juz ɪt ɑn ðɪs flɔr./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I should shower before nine.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Early mornings are always busy there.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, I will shower at night.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My first class starts at nine.
dialogue.zh: 我的第一堂課九點開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine starts at ten, so later.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have classes every day?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not Friday, that day is free.
dialogue.zh: 星期五沒有，那天是空的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hang our schedules on the wall.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good idea, then we know each other.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd aɪˈdiə ðɛn wi noʊ itʃ ˈʌðər./
dialogue.zh: 好主意，這樣我們就了解彼此。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What time do you eat breakfast?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: At seven, before my first class.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you wake me up tomorrow?
dialogue.zh: 你明天可以叫我起床嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, but you must get up.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I hate my alarm in the morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ heɪt maɪ əˈlɑrm ɪn ðə ˈmɔrnɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 我早上很討厭我的鬧鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Everyone does, but it still works.
dialogue.zh: 大家都這樣，但它還是有用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you want to walk to class?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju wɑnt tu wɔk tu klæs?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, the building is quite close.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How far is the dining hall?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About five minutes down the stairs.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are you hungry right now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little, I only had noodles.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is a small shop downstairs.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, I need a bottle of water.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt aɪ nid ə ˈbɑtəl əv ˈwɔtər./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us go down together then.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait, I need my wallet first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do not forget your room key.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks, it is in my pocket now.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks ɪt ɪz ɪn maɪ ˈpɑkɪt naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，現在在我口袋裡了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stairs are faster than the elevator.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: True, but my legs are tired.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We can take the elevator down.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fine, let us press the button.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tonight the shop closes at ten.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we have plenty of time.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I also need a small desk lamp.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈɔlsoʊ nid ə smɔl dɛsk læmp./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Me too, mine is still at home.
dialogue.phonetic: /mi tu maɪn ɪz stɪl æt hoʊm./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are you ready to go now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, just close the door please.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This place feels like home already.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same here, thanks for being friendly.
dialogue.zh: 我也這麼覺得，謝謝你這麼友善。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is getting dark outside now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then let us stay in tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are your earplugs in your bag?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, I still need to buy some.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ aɪ stɪl nid tu baɪ sʌm./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we buy these downstairs?
dialogue.zh: 我們可以在樓下買到這些嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I hope so, let us check.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you snore every single night?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only when I am very tired.
dialogue.zh: 只有我很累的時候才會。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You look tired after that long trip.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju lʊk ˈtaɪərd ˈæftər ðæt lɔŋ trɪp./
dialogue.zh: 你長途旅行後看起來很累。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I am, I woke up at five.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æm aɪ woʊk ʌp æt faɪv./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe you should sleep on your side.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmeɪbi ju ʃʊd slip ɑn jʊr saɪd./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will try that tonight, I promise.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl traɪ ðæt təˈnaɪt aɪ ˈprɑmɪs./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: If you snore, I will wake you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪf ju snɔr aɪ wɪl weɪk ju./
dialogue.zh: 如果你打呼，我會叫醒你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is fair, just be gentle.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: After ten the floor gets quiet.
dialogue.zh: 十點過後這層樓就安靜了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, I want to sleep early.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Some students are still talking outside.
dialogue.zh: 有些學生還在外面講話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They will go to bed soon.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we close the window now?
dialogue.zh: 我們現在要把窗戶關上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the night air is cold.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My blanket is still in the suitcase.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈblæŋkɪt ɪz stɪl ɪn ðə ˈsutˌkeɪs./
dialogue.zh: 我的毯子還在行李箱裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take it out before you sleep.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you feel cold at night too?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju fil koʊld æt naɪt tu?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A bit, this room has thin walls.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə bɪt ðɪs rum hæz θɪn wɔlz./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We should buy a warmer blanket.
dialogue.zh: 我們應該買條更暖的毯子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tomorrow, after our morning classes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is your first class tomorrow?
dialogue.zh: 你明天第一堂課是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Math, in the building next door.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My class is on the other side.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ klæs ɪz ɑn ði ˈʌðər saɪd./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we walk different ways tomorrow.
dialogue.zh: 那我們明天走不同方向。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have a phone charger?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but only one outlet works.
dialogue.zh: 有，但只有一個插座能用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We can charge our phones in turns.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kæn tʃɑrdʒ ˈaʊər foʊnz ɪn tɜrnz./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, you can go first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe this closet is too small.
dialogue.zh: 也許這個衣櫃實在太小了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I know, my jackets do not fit.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ noʊ maɪ ˈdʒækɪts du nɑt fɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我知道，我的外套放不下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We could hang them behind the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kʊd hæŋ ðɛm bɪˈhaɪnd ðə dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 我們可以把它們掛在門後。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That works, I have some hooks.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where did you put the hooks?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In the box near your desk.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Found them, they are quite strong.
dialogue.zh: 找到了，它們還滿牢固的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, hang your heavy coat there.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，把你厚外套掛那裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It looks better already.
dialogue.zh: 房間看起來已經好多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it feels like our place.
dialogue.zh: 對，感覺像我們的地方了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us unpack the small bag.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is the one with towels.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The big light is too bright.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we will turn it off.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The sheets are still in the bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ʃits ər stɪl ɪn ðə bæɡ/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let us make the bed now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will start with the sheet.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll put the sheet on.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is the fitted sheet?
dialogue.zh: 有鬆緊帶的床單在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's under the pillow.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This sheet feels really soft.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My mom packed it yesterday.
dialogue.zh: 我媽昨天幫我裝進去的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could you hold this corner with me?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd ju hoʊld ðɪs ˈkɔrnər wɪð mi/
dialogue.zh: 可以跟我一起抓這個角嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, hold this side tight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My pillowcase is inside out.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me fix it now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are there extra pillows?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One is in the closet.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My blanket is too short.

dialogue.speaker: char_b

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Time to fold the quilt now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, I'll take that end.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this my side of the room?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɪs maɪ saɪd əv ðə rum?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yeah, the left side is yours.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this mattress a little hard?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine feels hard too.

dialogue.text: Mine is an hour later.

issues.note: 142「Tonight the shop closes at ten.」與 233「It closes at ten tonight.」幾近同一句重述，238-239 又第三次提「until ten」；同一個打烊時間講三次，建議其中一對改寫成別的細節（折扣、人潮、找零）。非 error 級：三處分屬不同情境（排行程／查線上資訊／確認還開著），語意都接得住。
368「Let's close the window now.」與 168「Should we close the window now?」幾乎同句，169／369 也都接「冷」；建議改掉其中一對（例：368 改成「The room is getting cold.」）。非 error 級：一在傍晚、一在睡前，時間點不同。
184-185「Maybe this closet is too small.／my jackets do not fit.」與 094-095「Does this closet look small for two?／My clothes might not all fit.」是同一個抱怨 beat 重來；建議只留一處（184 該對可直接接 186-192 的鉤子收納線）。
全篇以「Let us／Let's」開頭約 30 次（046、098、102、135、141、151、195、200、222、251、301、329、331、339、347、351、356、368 等），是唯一明顯的句首單調來源；建議約三分之一換成「We can…／How about…／Shall we…」。非 error 級：睡前短句用祈使句本屬自然。

151「Then let us stay in tonight.」之後仍兩度外出（250-271 下樓買枕頭檯燈、301-345 去食堂），且 130-147 已約好下樓（134「Let us go down together then.」）卻在 148 起又留房整理百行、直到 251 才真的出門。句內無矛盾、未回收，屬情境小瑕；把 146-147 改成「Let's go after we finish this.」即可收線。

357 char_b「Mine is set for seven.」已說鬧鐘設好，376-377 又提醒「Set your alarm before you sleep.／I almost forgot that.」，前後略打結（且 375 才說可以睡到十點）。建議 377 改成「It's already set.」或 357 改成「Let's set it for seven.」。非 error 級：可解讀為睡前再確認一次。
010 同一把聲音先說「My name is Chen, with a C.」，052 又說「I am Alex.」。解讀為註冊用姓氏 Chen＋室友間用英文名 Alex 可通（且 010 的 with a C 對 Chen 略冗），但純聽感像換人；補一句過渡（Alex Chen）更穩。
200 char_a「I will start with the sheet.」與 201 char_b「I'll put the sheet on.」同一個動作各說一次，b 沒有推進資訊；可改成有分工的實詞（如「Then I'll take the other corner.」）。非 error 級：像邊做邊搭話，仍可聽。
「Good idea, then we know each other.」語意不完整，原意應是「就知道彼此的課表」；母語者會說 then we know each other's schedule。屬翻譯腔殘留，非 error 級。
「Throw the dirty clothes downstairs.」throw 用法偏翻譯腔，母語者多用 put／take the dirty clothes down to the laundry；同類輕微者：365「That helps me sleep fast.」（多說 fall asleep fast）、015「Two is fine, but not more.」（略書面）。
少量略高於 A2 的具體名詞：fitted sheet（202）、extension cord（266）、detergent（332）、curfew（316）、mattress pad（220）。皆為宿舍實物／實況詞且上下文立即解釋，不列超綱失分，僅供日後精修參考。

review.summary_zh: 本輪唯一修正已獨立核實：336 由「We should tell the front desk.」改為「They should fix it soon.」，與 231「We can tell the front desk.」的近似整句已解除，且 334-337（烘衣機壞→該修→已貼告示）語意自洽。全篇四維皆無 error 級問題：200 對問答逐對接得住、無純語氣詞的 b，情境自前檯取鑰匙→進房→室友相認→分床分工與規則→樓層設施→鋪床→採買→掛課表→晚餐→洗衣→盥洗就寢單線推進；事實前後一致（312 房在三樓、$8×2=$16、洗衣 $1.50、門禁十一點、A 九點／B 十點、店十點關）。僅餘風格項：142／233 打烊時間近句重述、168／368 關窗近句、094／184 衣櫃太小 beat 重複、Let's 句首偏多。C 項依機器證據給 25（SUSPECT 0、token 逐詞對齊通過），非我自行核音。
